bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to support for families; appropriating money for the family assets for independence program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; FAMILY ASSETS FOR INDEPENDENCE ONGOING FUNDING. +]

[+$1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $1,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for the purposes of the Minnesota family assets for independence initiative under section 142F.20. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to support for families; appropriating money for the family assets for independence program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; FAMILY ASSETS FOR INDEPENDENCE ONGOING FUNDING.

$1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $1,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for the purposes of the Minnesota family assets for independence initiative under section 142F.20.
additions: APPROPRIATION; FAMILY ASSETS FOR INDEPENDENCE ONGOING FUNDING.

$1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $1,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for the purposes of the Minnesota family assets for independence initiative under section 142F.20.
